name: lq-maintainer
description: Claude Code plugin that helps legalquants/lq-ai maintainers review PRs and issues against lq-ai's canon. Tiered review with a quick-pass default, a design path for greenfield work, and warm contributor-facing output. Every contribution is treated as sincere and with respect. A human decides, every time — the agent never merges, approves, closes, or pushes.
